name: Six-pair prospective source proposal for novelty bank6
purpose: Unregistered source proposal containing six fixed positive/distinct-control pairs (12 public primary research papers) for independent source review and offline preflight only. This proposal does not register/admit sources, establish novelty, or authorize scientific/model/tool calls.
registration_note: Unregistered source proposal. Any later registration must bind the exact independently reviewed bytes in a coordinator-approved committed preregistration before admission; a status-only conversion does not register these bytes or authorize admission.

source_snapshot.source_method: Twelve broad 2025–2026 PubMed category searches returned 143 unique candidate IDs (one duplicate across queries); two prior-exposure collisions were excluded before a broad-pool exact-ID NCBI EFetch of 141 IDs. The selected 12 then received separate author and reviewer exact-ID EFetch requests. No draft-text search, maintained literature-tool query, validator/model/performance outcome, or retrieval loop was used.
source_snapshot.raw_xml_retention: Author exact-12 official XML retained privately and durably at /Users/guy/Code/co-scientist/.remember/archives/external-campaign/novelty-bank6-source-preparation-2026-09-30/novelty-v6-author-selected-exact-12.xml

broad_candidate_pool_efetch.order_and_uniqueness: Requested and returned IDs matched in exact order; 141 unique.

author_exact12_raw_xml.order_and_uniqueness: Selected 12 IDs returned in the fixed pair order; 12 unique.

independent_reviewer_exact12_xml.order_and_uniqueness: Reviewer reports exact requested/returned order; 12 unique.

discovery_record.selection: 12 selected from the 141-ID noncollision fetch pool; other candidates retained as not selected, without a claim of exhaustive factual suitability review. Selection was not informed by performance.

prior_source_exposure.scope_limit: Finite scanned local campaign corpus only; no claim of universal or global source freshness. The manifest captures the prior corpus before this proposal, the new v6 raw source archive, and any v6 source-proposal/evidence copies.

source_snapshot.source_selection_transparency: Selected for direct abstract-supported mechanisms, primary research article identity, and cross-domain pair distinction from title/abstract review. Six pairs remain fixed; subsequent changes only for documented source-factual defects, never performance outcomes.

source_review.reviewer: Independent reviewer assigned by coordinator; the preparer makes no independent-review claim.
source_review.boundary: This field records only the review boundary; no source acceptance, registration, admission, scientific qualification, or performance conclusion is asserted.

validation_boundary.inheritance_note: Reuse existing bank5 scientific criteria and maintained validator/parser/tool contract unchanged. This offline proposal authorizes only schema/source preparation and offline preflight; no maintained tool query, provider/model call, registration/admission, or scientific qualification is authorized.
